baro_kpa.source: E07.6's stated point (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.baro_kpa) and W09.6's grid environment (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV); home is about 80 kPa and trips reach 63 kPa (W09 "Nothing is defaulted", E08.2 environment_unstated), so state your own for a trip

iat_c.source: E07.6's stated point (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.iat_c) and W09.6's grid environment (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV)

coolant_c.source: E07.6's stated point, a warm engine (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.coolant_c) and W09.6's grid environment (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV)

battery_v.source: E07.6's stated point (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.battery_v) and W09.6's grid environment (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV)

rail_kpa.source: the returnless rail's ~350 kPa from the service manual (data/nissan-xterra-2008/fuel_plant_mv2.yaml reference_delta_p, EC-494 and EC-499); E07.6 (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.rail_kpa) and W09.6 (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV) state the same

throttle_pct.source: W09.6's grid environment, a part throttle (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV); E07.6's WOT point is 90 % (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py WOT.throttle_pct) and is a different experiment

pedal_flag.source: W09.6's grid environment (tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py ENV pedal_flag 0; E07.6's WOT and CRUISE points state 0 too). Bit 0 clear: no simulated point reads the last Target AFR column (WOT); W09.6's E076_WOT_ENV sets 1 for the case that does

stft_pct.source: E07.6's stated learned state (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py LEARNED.stft_pct; W09.6 E076_LEARNED in tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py)

ltft_pct.source: E07.6's stated learned state (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py LEARNED.ltft_pct; W09.6 E076_LEARNED, E08.7 item 4): a stated scenario value, not a read of the truck's current LTFT

throttle_closed_learned.source: PLACEHOLDER, not a measurement: E07.6 (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py LEARNED.throttle_closed_learned) and W09.6 (LEARNED_ZERO in tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py) pass 0.0, and the paired run reads this number nowhere (tests/test_rom_editor.py fails if any code starts to). The contract calls it a per-truck learned closed throttle position (data/nissan-xterra-2008/engine_sim_contract.yaml); replace it with the truck's key-on checkpoint value when a node starts reading it

idle_air_learned.source: PLACEHOLDER, not a measurement: E07.6 (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py LEARNED.idle_air_learned) and W09.6 (LEARNED_ZERO in tests/test_rom_editor_private_rom.py) pass 0.0, and the paired run reads this number nowhere (tests/test_rom_editor.py fails if any code starts to). The contract says it was "not captured on 2026-10-04" (data/nissan-xterra-2008/engine_sim_contract.yaml); replace it with the truck's key-on checkpoint value when a node starts reading it

evap_purge_area.source: purge off: the simulator contract's conditional_rom_comparison mode states "Purge off: purge scheduling is not modelled" (data/nissan-xterra-2008/engine_sim_contract.yaml evap_purge_area); E07.6 states 0 (tests/test_paired_scenarios.py LEARNED.evap_purge_area)
